description: Implementation of the ImageProcessorWithPool class managing video frame processing with pooling, including creation, processing, and synchronization logic.

classes.name: ImageProcessorWithPool
classes.description: Manages video frame processing with a pool, handling frame processing, synchronization, and resource management.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize an ImageProcessorWithPool instance, validating buffer layout.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the processor state, clears pending frames, and invalidates weak pointers.

methods.name: HasPendingFrames
methods.description: Checks if there are frames pending processing or in the processor.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Queues a frame for processing and initiates processing.

methods.name: PumpProcessFrames
methods.description: Processes queued frames, retrieving frames from the pool and handling processing callbacks.

methods.name: OnFrameProcessed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a frame has been processed, runs the ready callback.
